description: The Apple Maps brands on this Apple Ads account. A BRAND IS THE ROOT OF EVERY ADS-ON-APPLE-MAPS CAMPAIGN and its id is what three other calls need: it is the promotedObjectId of a BUSINESS_BRAND campaign, the mapsBrandId upload_apple_ads_asset uploads against, and the mapsBrandId a LOCAL_ADS_SEARCH_CREATIVE carries. A brand must read eligibility ELIGIBLE before Apple will let a campaign use it. YOU CANNOT CREATE A BRAND HERE and that is Apple’s design, not a gap: brands come from Apple Business Connect, and Ads on Apple Maps additionally need the ad account to carry productFeatures BUSINESS_BRAND_MANUAL plus a BUSINESS_BRAND delegation, neither of which any API can grant. AN EMPTY LIST IS THE NORMAL ANSWER FOR AN APP STORE ADVERTISER and does not mean anything is broken — App Store campaigns need no brand at all. Read-only, free.

eligibilityStatus.description: Usually ELIGIBLE — only an ELIGIBLE brand can be used in a campaign.
